name: Echospace AE
description: Repeats the layer in real 3D like Trapcode Echospace: every instance is moved, turned and scaled from the one before it (linear or cumulative, so spirals, tunnels, fans and stairs come out by themselves), drawn around the layer's own position (Z included) and seen through the scene camera in perspective. Position and Z offset, rotation X / Y / Z, scale per instance, opacity falloff, start / end color, draw order and a manual camera fallback.
